what_the_brace_knows_it_does_not_know: growth-grammars (mandala and rosetta) are named but not instantiated as protocols
cross-brace coordination is named in SIBLINGS.md but no executable handshake exists yet
frame-substitution check in kernel_check.py operates at structural type level only, not linguistic level
probability vectors in this file are human-assigned priors, not cross-validated
speculative_areas: whether kernel_check.py's four-refusal set is complete or whether a fifth refusal is needed
whether brace_state.json should be queried by sibling braces or whether each brace keeps its own state private
whether future AI extensions will need a different shape ontology than verb/relation/process/artifact
what_the_brace_refuses_to_claim: that the probability vectors are precise
that the kernel is provably gameproof
that future AI will need exactly this shape
